# `oaap app throttle`

request limit per client address of an instance (RFC-0010).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app throttle [--route ROUTE] [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                         {show,set,off,reset} name [rate]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | -- |
| `rate` | <requests>/<seconds> per client address, e.g. 300/60 |
| `--route ROUTE` | one public route (its declared path, e.g. /vote): override the instance value for this route only |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `show` | yes |
| `set` | yes |
| `off` | yes |
| `reset` | yes |
